Exercise.description:
Exercises the movement classifier can emit.

v1 ships pull-up end to end; the rest are declared so the classifier and the
database schema are stable before the rules exist.
Exercise.title: Exercise

FormScores.description:
Continuous quality scores for one repetition.

Each field is a magnitude of deviation normalised to [0, 1], where 1.0 means
"no deviation detected". A rule never returns a boolean: the coaching layer
needs to say "tu ne descends pas assez bas" with a degree, not "rep invalide".

alignment.description: 1.0 = trunk/shoulder alignment held through the rep.
alignment.title: Alignment

kipping.description: 1.0 = no parasitic hip momentum. Derived from pelvis acceleration orthogonal to the movement axis.
kipping.title: Kipping

rom.description: Fraction of the athlete's calibrated range reached.
rom.title: Rom

symmetry.description: 1.0 = identical left/right joint angles through the rep.
symmetry.title: Symmetry

tempo_control.description: 1.0 = smooth, controlled velocity profile; low = jerky.
tempo_control.title: Tempo Control

FormScores.title: FormScores

Tempo.description:
Phase durations in seconds. Mirrors the usual eccentric/pause/concentric
notation used in strength programming.
Tempo.title: Tempo

description:
The central contract. Every counted repetition produces one of these.

Nothing in the system increments a bare counter: fatigue tracking, progression,
periodisation and the LLM coach are all built on the stream of RepEvents.

confidence.description: Fraction of frames in this rep whose driving landmarks were above the visibility threshold. Below ~0.7, corrections are suppressed.
confidence.title: Confidence

counted.description: Whether this rep counts toward the valid total. A rep can be recorded with poor scores and still count; `counted=False` is reserved for reps that failed the hard ROM floor.
counted.title: Counted

flags.description: Machine-readable issue codes, e.g. 'rom_short', 'kipping', 'left_lag'. Rendered to French by the UI, not stored in French.
flags.title: Flags

started_at_ms.description: Monotonic clock offset from session start, in milliseconds.
started_at_ms.title: Started At Ms

title: RepEvent
